question: What does the Augment Code Cosmos sign-up ask for, and what trial or complimentary credit does a new account get (length, amount, card at sign-up)?
why: behind a sign-up: cosmos.augmentcode.com redirects to login.augmentcode.com, which answered HTTP 400 to a request with no browser session on every read route.
